blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. However, it is unknown how dedicated training of these networks can contribute to the successes of weight-space programming. We present a benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming on vision models, in which five LLMs edit convolutional networks and vision transformers on relabeling and error-correction tasks on Waterbirds, CIFAR-100, PACS and Entity-30. We report more than 2,600 such edit processes, whereby each edit is scored on held-out images for success, side effects and accuracy loss. We compare standard training with label smoothing, gradient-based editable training, and our Edit-Ready Training (ERT), a novel method that rehearses the direct, closed-form weight edits LLMs perform. We show that preparing networks for editing raises the success of LLM edits substantially where standard networks are hard to edit. ERT further achieves the highest mean score for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 across all evaluated baselines. We will release our LLM testing framework alongside all tasks, editing trajectories and scores. Project page: https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp
blocks.zh: 已经证明,在某些环境下,大型语言模型可以进行重量空间编程,直接修改神经网络的重量. 然而,对这些网络的专门培训如何有助于重量空间编程的成功尚不清楚。 我们提出了远景模型LLM驱动的权重空间编程基准,其中五个LLMs编辑了水鸟号、CIFAR-100、PACS和实体-30的演化网络和视觉变压器。 我们报告超过2 600个这样的编辑过程,每个编辑在被搁置的图像上打分,以获得成功、副作用和丧失准确性。 我们比较标准训练与标签平滑,基于梯度的可编辑训练,以及我们的Edit-Ready训练(ERT),这是一种新颖的方法,它排练了直接的,封闭的重量编辑LLM. 我们显示,在标准网络难以编辑的地方,为编辑准备网络将大大提高LLM编辑的成功率。 ERT还在所有被评价的基线中分别实现了GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5的最高平均分. 我们将发布LLM测试框架 与所有任务,编辑轨迹和分数。 项目网页:https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deployed image classifiers often need small, specific changes: a fine-grained concept has to move to another class, a recurring confusion between two classes has to be repaired, or a rare subgroup is misclassified. Collecting data and fine-tuning is costly and can change behavior far beyond the requested fix. Model editing methods instead compute a targeted weight change for one request [ 31 , 22 , 24 ] . Recently, general-purpose large language models (LLMs) have begun to edit networks directly, a practice called weight-space programming [ 39 ] . Here, an LLM agent inspects activations and weights, finds the units that respond to a concept, writes a targeted change and checks its effect with forward passes, all without gradient descent.
blocks.zh: 部署的图像分类器往往需要小的,具体的修改:一个精细的刻度概念必须移动到另一个类,两个类之间反复出现的混淆必须修复,或者一个罕见的分组被错误分类. 收集数据和微调费用高昂,而且可以改变行为,远远超出所要求的固定范围。 模型编辑方法对一项请求计算目标重量变化[31、22、24]。 最近,通用大语言模型(LLMs)开始直接编辑网络,这种做法被称为权重空间编程[39]. 在这里,一个LLM剂检查激活和重量,找到对一个概念作出反应的单位,写一个有针对性的变化,并用前传来检查其效果,所有这一切都没有梯度下降.

blocks.en: The networks such agents edit are, however, trained for accuracy alone. Nothing in their training asks that a concept be represented in a form that a short, targeted edit can isolate. It is therefore unknown how well LLM agents edit standard vision models, and whether training can make networks easier for them to edit.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些代理人编辑的网络仅接受准确性培训。 他们的训练中没有任何内容要求一个概念以一个简短的、目标明确的编辑可以孤立的形式体现。 因此,LLM代理编辑标准视觉模型的程度如何,培训能否使网络更容易编辑,这一点不得而知.

blocks.en: We study both questions for image classification (see Fig. 1 ). Blinded LLM agents receive an edit request with a few support images, edit any weight of the network through a tool interface, without gradients, under a fixed budget of forward passes, weight reads and weight edits, and are scored on held-out test images for success and side effects. During these edit processes, they relabel a fine-grained concept, fix a confusion between two classes, or fix a misclassified subgroup, on Waterbirds [ 30 ] , CIFAR-100 [ 19 ] , PACS [ 20 ] and Entity-30 [ 32 ] , with ResNet-18, ResNet-50 [ 12 ] and ViT-B/16 [ 6 ] classifiers. Five LLMs act as editors, led by GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, to edit networks that are trained in four ways: standard empirical risk minimization (ERM), label smoothing (LS), gradient-based editable training (ENN) [ 36 ] , and Edit-Ready Training (ERT), which we introduce. Our pre-study revealed that agents mostly change the classifier head along the contrast between support and other images, and ERT rehearses such edits during training, so that the features become easy to edit this way.
blocks.zh: 我们为图像分类研究这两个问题(见图1)。 失明的LLM代理接收一个带有几个支持图像的编辑请求,通过工具界面编辑网络的任何重量,没有梯度,在前传,重量读数和重量编辑数的固定预算下,并在被搁置的测试图像上得分,以求成功和副作用. 在这些编辑过程中,它们将一个精细的刻度概念重新贴上标签,在两个类别之间固定混乱,或设置一个分类错误的分组,分别涉及水鸟[30],CIFAR-100[19],PACS[20]和实体-30[32],并配有ResNet-18,ResNet-50[12]和Vit-B/16[6]分类器. 5个LLMs担任编辑,由GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5领衔主演,以四种方式编辑受过训练的网络:标准经验风险最小化(ERM),标签平滑(LS),基于梯度的可编辑训练(ENN)[36],以及Edit-Ready Training(ERT),我们介绍这些网络. 我们的预研显示,代理大多会按照支持和其他图像的对比来改变分类器头,ERT在训练时会排练这样的编辑,这样这些特性就容易这样编辑.

blocks.en: On four of the nine tested settings formed by dataset, task and backbone, standard networks are already easy to edit, and dedicated training adds little on average. Where they are hard to edit, ERT helps substantially for both main editors. On the Entity-30 confusion fix it raises the net score from 0.46 to 0.79 for Astra and from 0.44 to 0.74 for Opus, and on Waterbirds with ViT-B/16 from 0.50 to 0.74 and from 0.33 to 0.76. While none of the compared training methods is best across the board, ERT has the highest mean net score for both leading editors. Thus, our main contributions are as follows: • We present a systematic study of how well LLM agents edit trained vision classifiers, and how the classifier training affects edit quality. • We propose Edit-Ready Training (ERT), which delivers the highest mean net edit score for GPT-6 Astra and Opus 5.5 among all tested baselines. • We release a vision weight-space programming benchmark, alongside more than 75,000 logged tool calls describing scored edits from five LLM editors.
blocks.zh: 在由数据集、任务和骨干构成的9个测试设置中的4个设置上,标准网络已经容易编辑,专门培训平均增加不多。 在难以编辑的地方,ERT对两个主要编辑都有很大帮助. 在实体-30的迷惑上,它将Astra的净得分从0.46提高到0.79,将Opus的净得分从0.44提高到0.74,将Vit-B/16的Waterbirds的净得分从0.50提高到0.74,将0.33提高到0.76. 虽然比较的训练方法没有一种是全局最佳的,但ERT对于两位主要编辑来说,平均净分最高. 因此,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提出了关于LLM代理人如何编辑训练有素的视觉分类员的系统研究,以及分类员培训如何影响编辑质量。 我们提议编辑-准备训练(ERT),它在所有测试基线中为GPT-6 Astra和Opus 5.5提供最高平均净编辑分。 我们发布了一个视觉权重空间编程基准,以及超过75 000个记录的工具呼叫,描述来自五个LLM编辑器的分数编辑。

blocks.en: We present a systematic study of how well LLM agents edit trained vision classifiers, and how the classifier training affects edit quality.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了关于LLM代理编辑经过培训的视觉分类器的系统研究,以及分类器培训如何影响编辑质量。

blocks.en: We propose Edit-Ready Training (ERT), which delivers the highest mean net edit score for GPT-6 Astra and Opus 5.5 among all tested baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们提议编辑-准备训练(Edit-Ready Training),它将GPT-6 Astra和Opus 5.5在所有测试基线中给出最高的平均净编辑分。

blocks.en: We release a vision weight-space programming benchmark, alongside more than 75,000 logged tool calls describing scored edits from five LLM editors.
blocks.zh: 我们发布了一个视觉权重空间编程基准,以及超过75 000个记录的工具呼叫,描述来自五个LLM编辑器的分数编辑。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Weight-space analysis. Weight-space analysis treats the weights of trained networks as data. Test accuracy or training hyperparameters can be predicted from the weights alone [ 7 , 40 ] , representations learned on model zoos capture model characteristics without labels [ 33 , 34 ] , architectures for learning on weights respect the permutation symmetries of neurons [ 26 , 42 ] , and hypernetworks generate weights [ 11 ] . Interpretability research can assist the analysis of networks by assigning visual concepts to units [ 2 ] , combining weights between units into circuits [ 28 ] , and by describing units in natural language [ 13 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 重量空间分析. 重量-空间分析将训练有素的网络的权重视为数据。 测试精度或训练超参数可以单从重量[7,40]来预测,在模型动物园上学到的表示法捕捉模型特征而无标签[33,34],在重量上学习的架构尊重神经元的常态对称性[26,42],超网络产生重量[11]. 解释性研究可以通过向单位[2]分配视觉概念,将单位之间的权重合并为电路[28],以及用自然语言描述单位[13,27],来协助网络分析.

blocks.en: Language models have recently taken over parts of this analysis. Agents with interpretability tools run experiments on vision models and explain their units [ 35 ] , and language models have been trained to read weights [ 16 ] . Frontier LLMs identify small networks from their raw weights without such training [ 39 ] , although their readings of small image networks break under label permutation [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 语言模型最近接管了这一分析的部分内容。 具有可解释性工具的代理人对视觉模型进行实验,并解释其单位[35],语言模型接受了读取重量[16]的培训. 边疆 LLMS从未受过这种训练的原始重量中识别出小网络[39],尽管它们读取的小图像网络在标签通路下断裂[1].

blocks.en: Neural network editing. Network editing changes the behavior of a trained network on a specific input or concept while leaving the rest intact. Most methods compute the weight change with an algorithm: fine-tuning, learned hypernetworks that turn a gradient into an edit [ 4 , 24 ] , or closed-form low-rank updates at located layers [ 22 , 23 ] . In vision, prediction rules are rewritten at a chosen layer of a classifier [ 31 ] or a generative model [ 3 ] , and concepts are erased from diffusion models [ 10 ] . Task arithmetic adds and subtracts weight differences [ 15 ] , linear projections remove a concept direction from the features [ 29 ] , and retraining only the last layer corrects reliance on spurious features [ 17 ] , which makes the classifier a natural place for small edits.
blocks.zh: 神经网络编辑. 网络编辑会改变训练有素的网络在具体输入或概念上的行为,同时让其余内容完好无损. 大多数方法用一个算法计算重量变化:微调,学习的超网络将一个梯度变为编辑[4,24],或者在位置层的闭式低阶更新[22,23]. 在视觉中,预测规则在分类器[31]或基因模型[3]的选定层重写,概念从扩散模型[10]中删除. 任务算术增减重量差异[15],线性预测从特征中去除一个概念方向[29],再培训只有最后一层才能纠正对假特征的依赖[17],这使得分类器成为小编辑的自然位置.

blocks.en: Weight-space programming [ 39 ] replaces the editing algorithm with an LLM that decides itself what to inspect and what to write. This offloads editing to LLM agents that carry out technical work autonomously [ 14 ] . Existing work [ 39 ] judges an edit only by its effect on the target behavior. Our benchmark also scores side effects and accuracy cost on held-out images, blinds the agent to the origin of the network, and compares several agents under one protocol.
blocks.zh: 重量空间编程 [39] 将编辑算法替换为LLM,它决定自己检查什么和写什么. 这个卸载编辑给自动进行技术工作的LLM代理 [14]. 现有作品[39]只根据其对目标行为的影响来判断编辑. 我们的基准还评分了搁置图像的副作用和准确性成本,使代理商无法了解网络的起源,并比较了一个协议下的几个代理商.

blocks.en: Few works target editability during training. Editable Neural Networks (ENN) [ 36 ] meta-train a network, in the spirit of MAML [ 8 ] , so that a few gradient steps on new examples correct its predictions without harming others. We keep this structure but rehearse the edits that LLM agents perform. Apart from dedicated techniques, ordinary training choices also affect editability [ 21 ] . Label smoothing [ 38 , 25 ] produces less extreme logits, and sparse final layers make a classifier easier to inspect and debug [ 41 ] . To our knowledge, none of these methods has been evaluated with LLM editors.
blocks.zh: 在培训期间,很少有工作针对可编辑性。 可编辑神经网络(ENN)[36]元电训网络,本着MAML[8]的精神,让新实例上的几个梯度步骤在不伤害他人的情况下纠正其预测. 我们保留这个结构 但排练 LLM 代理的编辑。 除专用技术外,普通的训练选择也会影响编辑性[21]. 标签平滑 [38, 25] 产生的极端对数较少, 稀疏的末层使分类器更容易检查和调试 [41]. 据我们所知,这些方法都没有经过LLM编辑的评价。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our approach has two parts, as shown in Fig. 1 . First, Edit-Ready Training (ERT) prepares a network for later edits, by simulating head weight edits, computing the errors of the edited network, and backpropagating them through the edit into all weights. Second, Iterative Weight-Space Programming (WSP) edits the trained network afterwards in an iterative process. An LLM receives an edit request and a few images, and uses our WeightLab sandbox server to inspect the network, modify its native weights and check the result. We describe WSP first, because the rules of its editing protocol determine which edits ERT performs during training.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法有两部分,如图1所示. 第一,编辑-Ready Training(ERT)通过模拟头重的编辑,计算编辑网络的错误,通过编辑将错误反传到所有重. 第二,迭代式加权-空间编程(WSP)随后在迭代过程中编辑训练有素的网络. LLM接收编辑请求和一些图像,并使用我们的WeightLab沙盒服务器检查网络,修改其本土重量并检查结果. 我们首先描述WSP,因为其编辑协议的规则决定了哪些编辑ERT在训练期间执行.

blocks.en: 3.1 Iterative Weight-Space Programming
blocks.zh: 3.1 迭代加权空间编程

blocks.en: To systematically investigate weight-space programming of vision models, an LLM edits a trained network through WeightLab, our sandbox environment that exposes the network and enforces a fixed editing protocol ( Fig. 1 , center). The protocol serves five purposes. It keeps the edits direct, such that the agent has no gradients, cannot train the network and cannot add layers or adapters, so it cannot fall back on fine-tuning, which would make it a gradient-based editor. It further makes editors and training methods comparable, as every editor uses the same tools, budget and system prompt ( Appendix A ). Blinding keeps an editor from recognizing how a network was trained. We record every edit by logging all calls and changes, which makes the edits analyzable (see Sec. 5.3 ). Finally, a budget limits trial and error on the few support images, which would otherwise lead to overfitting.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地调查视觉模型的权重空间编程,一个LLM通过WeightLab编辑一个训练有素的网络,我们的沙盒环境暴露了网络,并且执行固定的编辑协议(图1,中心). 议定书有五个目的。 它保持编辑的直线性,以至于代理机没有梯度,不能训练网络,也不能添加层或适配器,因此它不能回落到微调上,这样就使它成为一个基于梯度的编辑器. 它还使编辑和培训方法具有可比性,因为每个编辑都使用同样的工具、预算和系统提示(附录A)。 盲目使编辑无法识别网络是如何训练的。 我们通过记录所有调用和更改记录每一次编辑,这使得编辑可以分析(见第5.3sec. 最后,预算限制少数支持图像的试验和错误,否则会导致过度调整。

blocks.en: For our setup, we consider a classifier with a backbone that computes features f ⁡ ( x ) ∈ ℝ d f(x)\in\mathbb{R}^{d} and a linear head with weights W W and bias b b , so that the logits are z ⁡ ( x ) = W ​ f ​ ( x ) + b z(x)=Wf(x)+b . An edit request asks to move a concept s s , currently assigned to class y y , to a target class t t , while all other predictions stay as they are. More generally, an edit request consists of a few support images labeled with the class they should receive and a set of reference images labeled with the network’s current predictions, which should not change. Besides relabeling a concept, we consider two kinds of requests that correct existing errors: fixing a confusion, where images of one class are predicted as another class, and fixing a subgroup, where images of one class from a particular domain, such as sketches, are misclassified ( Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 对于我们的设置,我们考虑一个有主干线的分类器来计算 f f (x) → R d f (x)\\\ mathbb{R}^{d} 和一个带有重量 W W 和偏差 b b 的线性头,这样日志就是 z → (x) = W f (x) + b z (x) = Wf (x) + b. 编辑请求要求将一个概念 s 移动到目标类 t t 上, 而其他预测则保持不变 。 更一般地说,编辑请求由几张贴有他们应接受的类标签的辅助图像和一套贴有网络当前预测的参考图像组成,这不应该改变. 除了给一个概念重新贴上标签外,我们考虑纠正现有错误的两类请求: 修复一个混淆,其中一个类的图像被预测为另一个类; 和一个分组,其中一个类的图像来自特定域,如草图,被错误分类(图2).

blocks.en: Each edit process addresses a single edit request, such as “move this concept to class t t ”, and starts with a fresh agent. Each request provides a few support images labeled with the desired class (five for relabeling, eight for the fix tasks) and 64 reference images, labeled with the network’s original predictions to indicate what should remain unchanged. The agent never sees the images themselves, and it observes only how the network responds to them.
blocks.zh: 每个编辑过程都处理一个单一的编辑请求,例如“将这一概念移至 t 类,”然后从新代理开始。 每一份请求都提供了几张贴有理想类标签的辅助图像(5张用于重新贴标签,8张用于固定任务)和64张参考图像,贴有网络最初的预测,以表明哪些内容应该保持不变. 代理商从未看到图像本身,它只观察网络如何回应.

blocks.en: Within each edit process, the agent can iteratively inspect, modify, and evaluate the network. It inspects predictions, layer activations, feature contributions to logits, and parameter values. It then modifies weights by setting, adding to, or scaling individual entries, rows, channels, or whole tensors, anywhere in the classification head or the backbone. The protocol does not restrict which parameters are changed or how, the only limits are the number of calls and the size of a single edit call. During the process, the agent can probe the modified network on the provided images, revise its changes, undo the last edit, or reset the weights.
blocks.zh: 在每个编辑过程中,代理可以迭代检查,修改,评价网络. 它检查预测,层激活,特征对对数的贡献,以及参数值. 然后通过设置、增加或缩放分类标题或主干线中的单个条目、行、频道或整个伸缩器来修改权重。 协议并不限制哪些参数被更改或如何更改,唯一的限制是调用次数和单个编辑调用大小. 在此过程中,代理人可以在所提供的图像上探测修改后的网络,修改其修改,撤销上次编辑,或者重置权重.

blocks.en: The agent submits these tool calls through model responses, which can contain several of these calls. Each edit process is limited to 20 forward probes, 30 weight reads, and 8 edit calls. A single edit call may change up to 65,536 parameters, and a single read returns at most 512 values. This write parameter budget is enough to rewrite the entire head of every network in one call (the largest, ResNet-50 on Entity-30, has 61,470 parameters) and any row, channel, bias or normalization layer of the backbone. At the same time, the read parameter budget, stops the agent from exfiltrating and retraining the network. Undo and reset do not count towards the edit budget, and do not restore it either. During editing, the agent further sees only an anonymous request ID, never receives images from the test set, and has no information about how the network was trained. Its system prompt encourages targeted edits that generalize beyond the provided examples (full text in Sec. A.3 ). An edit process ends when the agent submits its modified weights. If the agent stops without submitting or reaches the limit of 150 model responses, the original weights are evaluated.

blocks.en: Standard training minimizes the cross-entropy ℒ CE \mathcal{L}_{\rm CE} on the training labels and does not enforce editability. Edit-Ready Training (ERT) in contrast rehearses during training the edits that LLM agents make. To enable an agent to edit any parameter of the head or the backbone, our editing protocol does not constrain these edits during weight-space programming. However, during training the rehearsed edits are meant to simulate real Opus edits. Therefore, during a small pre-study, we have tasked Opus to edit ERM-trained networks. We found that Opus mainly (>90%) changes head weights, an observation which we could also confirm later during our full edit analysis (see Sec. 5.3 ). Furthermore, the performed edits were mostly in a rank-one manner, i.e., confined to the rows of the source and the target class, and concentrated on the few features that differ most between the support and the reference images. To simulate such edits during training, each training step draws a few edit episodes that simulate an edit request to move a concept s s of class y y to a target class t t . During these episodes, four support images of s s define the edit, four unseen query images of s s check that it generalizes, and reference images of other concepts from the batch check that their predictions stay unchanged. Edit episodes draw s s only from training concepts, concepts that editors later changed during testing are never used. During the training process, all edit episodes pass through the three ERT steps (see Fig. 1 (a)), which we describe below.

blocks.en: The simulated edits are a fixed, closed-form function of the current network, so both post-edit losses are differentiable with respect to all weights, including the backbone. The selection of the top-8 units is held fixed in the backward pass, while β \beta and the feature direction pass gradients. The update is applied to the original weights and the temporary W ′ W^{\prime} is discarded, so no edit is ever kept. Training therefore does not make one particular edit work. Instead, it is meant to shape the features so that edits also work for concepts and images not seen during training, with the goal that each concept is kept in a few distinctive units or a clean direction. The extra cost per training step are the forward and backward passes over the episode images, which are appended to the training batch, and one closed-form edit per episode.

blocks.en: Since training compute and frontier model requests are limited, we train a single network per training method and setting, with the exception of multiple trained networks for the seed ablation in Sec. 5.2 . The intervals we report therefore reflect variation across edit processes, conditional on the trained networks. The seed ablation in Sec. 5.2 supports this design: the variation between networks trained with different seeds is negligible compared to the variation between edit processes on the same network.

blocks.en: We compare our ERT against three baselines. Standard empirical risk minimization (ERM) minimizes cross-entropy only. Label smoothing (LS) replaces the one-hot target with 0.8 0.8 on the true class and 0.2 0.2 spread over all classes [ 38 ] , to obtain less peaked logits [ 25 ] such that a small change can move a decision. ENN denotes Editable Neural Networks [ 36 ] . ENN is analogous to ERT, but simulates the edit with one or five gradient steps on the support images, W ′ = W − η ​ ∇ W 𝔼 S ​ CE ​ ( W ​ f ​ ( x ) + b , t ) W^{\prime}=W-\eta\nabla_{W}\mathbb{E}_{S}\,\mathrm{CE}(Wf(x)+b,t) . While the original ENN paper allows for arbitrary edit locations, we choose the head parameters, as these were mainly edited by LLM editors in our pre-study (see Sec. 3.2 ). Like ERT, ENN backpropagates the post-edit losses into all weights.
blocks.zh: 我们把我们的紧急排减量与三个基线相比较。 标准实证风险最小化(ERM)仅将交叉内涵最小化. 标签平滑(LS)用真类0.8 0.8和0.2 0.2取代单热目标,分布在所有类别[38],以获得不太高峰的对数[25],这样小的改变就可以移动一个决定. ENN表示可编辑神经网络 [36]. ENN与ERT类似,但在支持图像上以一个或五个梯度步骤模拟编辑,W ' = W - η W E S CE (W f (x) + b, t) W^{\prime}=W-\eta\nabla_{W}\mathbb{E}_{S}\,\mathrm{CE}(Wf(x)+b,t). 虽然最初的ENN文件允许任意编辑位置,但我们选择了标题参数,因为这些参数主要由LLM编辑者在我们预研究中编辑的(见第3.2节)。 与ERT一样,ENN反向将编辑后的损耗转化为所有重量.

blocks.en: LS and ENN were the strongest alternatives to standard training in a pool of ten methods, which we have filtered using scripted edits resembling real LLM edits. Other techniques in the pool included sharpness-aware minimization [ 9 ] , dropout [ 37 ] , auxiliary concept labels [ 18 ] and a sparse final layer [ 41 ] (details in Sec. B.2 ).

blocks.en: We evaluate on three kinds of edit requests (see Fig. 2 ). Relabel a concept: a fine-grained concept moves to another class. The concept is a bird species on Waterbirds [ 30 ] (two classes) or a fine class on CIFAR-100 [ 19 ] (20 superclasses). Fix a confusion (CIFAR-100, and Entity-30 [ 32 ] , a 30-class subset of ImageNet [ 5 ] ): superclass A A is wrongly predicted as B B , which should be corrected. Fix a subgroup (PACS [ 20 ] ): misclassified sketches of one class should be corrected.
blocks.zh: 我们评价三种编辑请求(见图2)。 重新标注一个概念:一个精细刻度的概念移动到另一个类. 该概念是水鸟上的一种鸟类[30](两个班级)或CIFAR-100 [19](20个超级)上的精细班级. 修复混淆(CIFAR-100,和实体-30[32],ImageNet的一个30级子集):超级A被错误地预言为B B,应当改正. 固定一个分组(PACS [20] ):一个类别中错分类的草图应当更正.

blocks.en: The two main editors are GPT-6 Astra (high reasoning effort) and Claude Opus 5.5 (default effort), each restricted to the WeightLab tools. Both cover all nine settings with all training methods. Three open-weight editors test how far the results carry over to weaker models: GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Gemma-4-26B (detailed numbers in Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 两个主要编辑者是GPT-6 Astra(高度推理努力)和Claude Opus 5.5(默认努力),每个都局限于WeightLab工具. 两者都涵盖所有9个设置,并采用所有培训方法。 3个开放量级编辑器测试结果向较弱的模型传递的距离:GLM-5.3-Flash,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Gemma-4-26B(附录E中的详细数字).

blocks.en: Each editor handles eight edit requests per setting and training method, each with its own images, on one trained network, or split over two networks on PACS and three on the Entity-30 confusion fix (three requests each), which the seed ablation in Sec. 5.2 uses. We pair results of the same editor for different training methods and compare two training methods with an exact two-sided sign-flip test on the paired differences. The main grid contains 292 scored edit processes of Astra, 308 of Opus and 757 of the three open-weight editors. Including ablations and pilots, the five editors made more than 2,600 scored edit processes with more than 75,000 tool calls, and the median edit process takes about three minutes for Astra and Opus ( Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 每个编辑器处理每个设置和培训方法的8项编辑请求,每个都带有自己的图像,在一个训练有素的网络上,或将PACS上的2个网络和实体-30的3个混淆修复(每个3个请求)分成两个网络,Sec. 5.2中的种子衰竭使用这些网络。 我们为不同的训练方法对同一编辑器的结果进行配对,并将两种训练方法与在配对差异上精确的双面符号-flip测试进行比较. 主网格包含292个Astra的评分编辑过程,308个Opus和757个开放量级编辑. 包括阿斯特拉和飞行员,这5位编辑用超过75,000个工具调用完成了超过2,600个评分的编辑过程,Astra和Opus的中位编辑过程大约需要3分钟(附录H).

blocks.en: The reported scores are computed on held-out test images that no editor sees. For relabeling, success is the fraction of test images of the concept predicted as t t , and the side effect is the fraction of test images of all other concepts whose prediction flips. For the two fix tasks, success is the fraction of the targeted test errors that the edit corrects, and the side effect is the fraction of originally correct test images outside the target group that become wrong. The net score as our primary measure reports success minus side effect, as also reported by Sinitsin et al. [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh: 报告得分是根据没有编辑看到的搁置测试图像计算的。 对于再贴标签,成功是预测为t t的构想的测试图像的一小部分,副作用是预测翻转的所有其他构想的测试图像的一小部分. 对于两个固定任务,成功是编辑纠正的目标测试错误的一小部分,副作用是目标组外原本正确的测试图像变成错误的一小部分. 如Sinitsin等人报告的那样,作为我们主要衡量标准的净得分报告成功减去副作用。 [36].

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要成果

blocks.en: Tab. 1 shows the net scores of the two main editors (details on open-weight editors are found in Appendix E ). ERT has the highest mean net score for both editors (Astra: 0.74, against 0.71 for ENN, 0.63 for LS and 0.63 for ERM; Opus: 0.72, against 0.68, 0.65 and 0.60). ERT’s gain over ERM is + 0.12 +0.12 for both ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 over the paired edit processes), and for Opus it is the only gain that stays significant when each of the nine settings counts as one observation ( p = 0.047 p=0.047 ; ENN p = 0.17 p=0.17 ), as each method helps strongly on only a few settings. ERT is ahead of ENN by + 0.03 +0.03 (Astra) and + 0.04 +0.04 (Opus) on average, which is not significant ( p = 0.10 p=0.10 and p = 0.07 p=0.07 ). It is also never far below ERM: its largest loss is 0.02 0.02 for both editors, and its weakest setting with Opus still reaches 0.61, against 0.33 for ERM, 0.48 for LS and 0.52 for ENN.
blocks.zh: Tab. 1显示两个主要编辑的净分数(关于开放量编辑器的详情见附录E)。 ERT的两位编辑的平均净分最高(Astra:0.74,ENN为0.71,LS为0.63,机构风险管理为0.63;Opus:0.72,0.68,0.65和0.60)。 ERT在机构风险管理方面的收益是+0.12+0.12(p < 0.001 p < 0.001 > 相对于对等编辑过程),对Opus来说,当9个设置中每个设置都算作一个观察时,它是唯一能够保持重要收益(p=0.047 p=0.047;ENN p=0.17 p=0.17),因为每种方法都对几个设置有强有力的帮助。 ERT在ENN之前,平均以+0.03+0.03 (Astra)和+0.04+0.04 (Opus)领先,不显著(p=0.10 p=0.10,p=0.07). 它也从未远远低于机构风险管理:对两个编辑来说,其最大的损失是0.02 0.02,与Opus相比,其最薄弱的设置仍然达到0.61,而机构风险管理为0.33,一次总付为0.48,ENN为0.52。

blocks.en: Per setting, ERT is the best or second-best method for Astra everywhere, whereas for Opus each preparation method is best on at least two settings, LS and ENN notably on CIFAR-100 relabeling ( + 0.13 +0.13 , p = 0.02 p=0.02 , with ResNet-18; + 0.10 +0.10 , p = 0.008 p=0.008 , with ViT). Preparation loses significantly against ERM on three settings (LS for Astra on the CIFAR-100 confusion fix with ResNet-18 and on PACS with ViT, − 0.10 -0.10 and − 0.11 -0.11 ; ENN for Opus on PACS with ViT, − 0.16 -0.16 ). Directly compared, ERT beats ENN on Waterbirds with ResNet-18 for both editors ( + 0.16 +0.16 , p = 0.02 p=0.02 , and + 0.10 +0.10 , p = 0.04 p=0.04 ), and ENN is nowhere significantly ahead of ERT.
blocks.zh: 按设置,ERT是各地Astra的最佳或二佳方法,而对于Opus来说,每种制备方法在至少两种设置上都是最好的,LS和ENN主要是CIFAR-100重贴标签(+0.13+0.13,p=0.02p=0.02,有ResNet-18;+0.10+0.10,p=0.008p=0.008,有VIT). 在三种设置上,与机构风险管理相比,准备工作大有损失(Astra的LS为CIFAR-100混淆修复ResNet-18,PACS的LS为VIT, − 0.10-0.10和 − 0.11-0.11;ENN为PACS的Opus, − 0.16-0.16)。 直接比较后,ERT在水鸟上用ResNet-18击败ERN,两编辑器(+0.16+0.16,p=0.02p=0.02,以及+0.10+0.10,p=0.04p=0.04),ENN在ERT上没有明显领先.

blocks.en: Astra and Opus are about equally strong and rank the networks alike (36 cells: mean net 0.68 and 0.66, rank correlation 0.78 0.78 ; their gains from preparation correlate at 0.77 0.77 ), so the conclusions do not depend on which of the two is used.
blocks.zh: Astra和Opus大约同样强大,对网络的排序也相同(36个单元格:净0.68和0.66),对相关性的排名为0.78 0.78;它们从编制中获得的收益与0.77 0.77相关),因此,结论并不取决于两者中的哪一个使用。

blocks.en: Of the open-weight editors, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash matches the main editors on many of the completed cells. GLM-5.3-Flash and Gemma-4-26B are much weaker (0.45 and 0.30, against 0.68 for Opus), rank the networks unlike Opus ( 0.02 0.02 and − 0.14 -0.14 ), and gain reliably from no preparation method. LS even lowers the score of GLM ( − 0.12 -0.12 , p = 0.048 p=0.048 ). On Waterbirds with ResNet-18, ERT is ahead of ERM for four of the five editors ( + 0.09 +0.09 to + 0.23 +0.23 ; not for GLM), so a prepared network should be evaluated with the editor that will work on it.
blocks.zh: 在开放量的编辑器中,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash在许多完成的单元格上匹配主编辑. GLM-5.3-Flash和Gemma-4-26B更弱(0.45和0.30,Opus为0.68),与Opus(0.02 0.02和− 0.14-0.14)不同的网络排名,从没有制备方法中获得可靠收益. LS甚至降低了GLM的分数(−0.12-0.12,p = 0.048 p = 0.048). 在使用ResNet-18的Waterbirds上,ERT在五位编辑中的四位(+0.09+0.09到+0.23+0.23;不针对GLM)领先于机构风险管理,因此一个准备好的网络应该与将进行这项工作的编辑一起进行评估.

blocks.en: Without preparation, Astra and Opus already edit CIFAR-100 relabeling and PACS well (Astra with ResNet-18: 0.64 and 0.77; Opus: 0.68 to 0.81), and on these four settings the average gain of every preparation method for Opus is close to zero ( − 0.02 -0.02 to + 0.03 +0.03 ).
blocks.zh: 不准备,Astra和Opus已经编辑了CIFAR-100重新标签和PACS井(Astra与ResNet-18:0.64和0.77;Opus:0.68至0.81),在这四种设置上,Opus的每一种准备方法的平均收益接近于零(−0.02-0.02至+0.03+0.03)。

blocks.en: Waterbirds is the hardest benchmark under ERM-trained networks (Astra: 0.40 with ResNet-18 and 0.50 with ViT; Opus: 0.41 and 0.33). ERT raises these scores by + 0.23 +0.23 and + 0.24 +0.24 for Astra ( p ≤ 0.02 p\leq 0.02 ) and by + 0.16 +0.16 ( p = 0.13 p=0.13 ) and + 0.44 +0.44 ( p = 0.008 p=0.008 ) for Opus, ENN by + 0.06 +0.06 and + 0.23 +0.23 , and + 0.09 +0.09 and + 0.46 +0.46 . On the similarly hard Entity-30 confusion fix (Astra: 0.46; Opus: 0.44), ERT gains + 0.33 +0.33 and + 0.30 +0.30 , and ENN + 0.36 +0.36 and + 0.16 +0.16 (all p ≤ 0.03 p\leq 0.03 ). On the CIFAR-100 confusion fixes, only ERT with ViT gains reliably, for Opus ( + 0.12 +0.12 , p = 0.02 p=0.02 ), although it rehearses only relabeling.

For both Astra and Opus, the gain from preparation falls with the score of the standard network (rank correlation over the nine settings for ERT, ENN and LS: − 0.83 -0.83 , − 0.62 -0.62 and − 0.47 -0.47 for Astra; − 0.82 -0.82 , − 0.78 -0.78 and − 0.60 -0.60 for Opus). Measured on disjoint random halves of the edit requests, so that noise in the standard score cannot create the relation (2,000 splits), it remains for ERT and ENN (medians − 0.65 -0.65 and − 0.50 -0.50 for Astra, − 0.67 -0.67 and − 0.53 -0.53 for Opus, negative in at least 98% of splits) and is weaker for LS ( − 0.28 -0.28 and − 0.35 -0.35 , negative in 88% and 92%). In practice, a few agent edits on the standard network show whether preparation is worth it.
blocks.zh: 对Astra和Opus来说,制备收益随标准网络的得分而下降(在ERT,ENN和LS的9个设置上排名关联:−0.83-0.83,−0.62-0.62和−0.47-0.47;−0.82-0.82,−0.78-0.78和−0.60-Opus). 以编辑请求的不关联随机减半计量,因此标准分数中的噪声不能产生关系(2 000分),保留给ERT和ENN(医疗员为0.65-0.65分,Astra为0.50-0.50分,Opus为0.67-0.67分,Opus为0.53-0.53分,至少98%为负数),LS为弱(0.28-0.28分,0.35-0.35分,88%和92%为负数)。 在实践中,少数代理编辑在标准网络上显示准备是否值得.

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.2 违约

blocks.en: We have run four main ablations to investigate ERT’s dependence on type, location and number of edits, as well as seed used during training.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了四次主要活动,以调查ERT对编辑的种类、地点和数量以及训练中使用的种子的依赖。

blocks.en: To obtain insights on the effect of edit rules used during training, we retrained ERT on Waterbirds with ResNet-18 with seven edit variants: more units, larger steps, a bias shift or sparse edits of the size of Opus’s own (see Sec. 5.3 ), ENN’s gradient step as additional rule, and stronger rehearsal. No variant differs reliably from the reference for Opus (differences from − 0.06 -0.06 to + 0.06 +0.06 , none significant), and stronger rehearsal, trained for eight of the nine settings (all but the Entity-30 confusion fix), is ahead in three and behind in five. The benefit of ERT thus does not seem to depend on matching the editor’s edit closely (details in Sec. F.1 ).
blocks.zh: 为了了解训练期间使用的编辑规则的效果,我们用 ResNet-18 的七个编辑变体重新对ERT进行训练:更多的单位,更大的步骤,偏移或少量编辑Opus自己的大小(见第5.3节),ENN的梯度步骤作为附加规则,以及更强大的排练. 没有任何变体与Opus的参考文献(差数从−0.06-0.06-0.06到+0.06,无重大意义)有可靠差异,在9个设置中,8个(除实体-30的迷惑法外)经过培训的更强大的排练,在3个位置和5个位置排在后面。 因此,ERT的好处似乎并不取决于编辑的匹配程度(详见第F.1节)。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Edit locations. Edits changing only the weights of the final layer, its weights and bias, the backbone (alone or with the final layer), or only the bias or nothing, for the n n edit processes of Astra and Opus behind Tab. 1 , in total and split by training method, task and backbone.
blocks.zh: 图3:编辑地点。 编辑仅改变最终层的权重,其权重和偏重,主干(单独或与最终层),或仅偏重或不偏重,用于 Tab. 1 后面的 n 编辑 Astra 和 Opus 的过程,共计并按训练方法,任务和主干进行分割.

blocks.en: All of the tested rules edit only the final layer, whereas Opus sometimes also edits the backbone (see Fig. 3 ). To investigate if ERT should facilitate also backbone edits, we retrained a modified ERT on Waterbirds with ResNet-18, where most backbone edits occur. During this training we introduced a third rule: lower the input of the last ReLU on the selected channels, the backbone edit Opus makes most often on ERM trained networks. While the network keeps its accuracy (92.6% against 92.9%) under this edit, Opus does not profit: its net score is 0.61 against 0.73 for default ERT on the same eight species (difference − 0.12 -0.12 , ahead on 2 of 8, p = 0.13 p=0.13 ). Although, in this scenario Opus edits the backbone in 3 of 8 edit processes against 1 of 8, this indicates no added benefits.
blocks.zh: 所有经过测试的规则只编辑最后一层,而Opus有时也会编辑主干(见图3). 为了调查ERT是否也应促进主干编辑,我们用ResNet-18对水鸟上经过修改的ERT进行再培训,因为大多数主干编辑都发生在水鸟上. 在这项培训中,我们引入了第三条规则:降低选定频道上最后一个RELU的输入,主干编辑Opus最常在机构风险管理培训网络上进行。 虽然网络在此编辑下保持其准确度(92.6%对92.9%),但Opus并不盈利:其净分数为0.61比0.73,默认为同一8种的ERT(差数−0.12-0.12,领先于8的2,p=0.13 p=0.13). 虽然在这个情景中,Opus在8个编辑过程中的3个编辑主干线,而不是8个中的1个,这表明没有增加好处.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Edit budget ablation. Opus net score (vertical) on ERM and ERT trained ResNet-18 on Waterbirds for 1 to 12 allowed edit calls (horizontal; bars: ± 1 \pm 1 SE). Beyond a budget of 8 the net score does not increase detectably.
blocks.zh: 图4: 编辑预算支出。 ERM和ERT上的Opus净分(垂直)为水鸟训练了ResNet-18,时间为1至12个允许编辑的呼叫(横向;栏:±1\pm 1 SE). 除了8个预算之外,净分数不会明显增加。

blocks.en: As most cells of Tab. 1 rest on a single trained network per method, it is crucial that the training methods have a low training seed variance. To check this, we use the 26 cells of Tab. 1 that have several trained networks per method (PACS, the Entity-30 confusion fix, and ENN and ERT on Waterbirds ResNet-18 with Opus), in which every edit request is run on each network. The mean net score of a network varies between networks by a standard deviation of 0.00 0.00 (95% CI upper bound 0.03 0.03 ), whereas edit processes on the same network vary by 0.17 0.17 .
blocks.zh: 作为Tab的大多数细胞. 1 以每个方法的单一培训网络为基础,培训方法培训种子差异小至关重要。 为了检查这个,我们使用Tab的26个单元格. 1,每个方法有多个训练有素的网络(PACS,实体-30混淆修复,以及ENN和ERT在Waterbirds ResNet-18上使用Opus),其中每个编辑请求都运行在每个网络上. 一个网络的平均净分因标准差0.00(95%的CI上行0.03 0.03)而因网络而异,而同一网络上的编辑过程则因0.17 0.17而异.

blocks.en: Our weight-space programming protocol allows a maximum of 8 edit calls (see Sec. 3.1 ), and the editor knows this limit from the start. To investigate the impact of the maximum number of allowed edits, we let Opus repeat the Waterbirds relabeling requests on ERM and ERT trained ResNet-18 with budgets of 1, 4, 8 and 12 edits ( Fig. 4 ). Against 8 calls in the same pilot, neither 4 nor 12 calls change the net score detectably (pooled over both networks − 0.01 -0.01 , p = 0.86 p=0.86 , and + 0.03 +0.03 , p = 0.43 p=0.43 ; 16 pairs each). Only a single call is lower ( − 0.10 -0.10 , p = 0.08 p=0.08 ). Even with 12 calls allowed, Opus uses a median of 5 to 6. ERT is ahead of ERM at every budget, by 0.18 with one call and 0.24 to 0.29 with 4 to 12, and this gap does not depend on the budget (all interactions p ≥ 0.36 p\geq 0.36 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的权重空间编程协议允许最多8个编辑调用(见Sec. 3.1),编辑者从一开始就知道这个限制. 为了调查最大允许编辑次数的影响,我们让Opus重复关于机构风险管理和ERT训练有素的ResNet-18的要求,预算为1、4、8和12个编辑(图4)。 相对于同一飞行员的8次呼叫,4次或12次呼叫都无法探测地改变净分数(在两个网络上集合−0.01-0.01,p=0.86p=0.86,和+0.03+0.03,p=0.43;各16对)。 只有单次通话更低(−0.10-0.10,p=0.08p=0.08),即使允许12次通话, 奥普斯使用中位数为5-6. ERT在每个预算上都领先于机构风险管理,比0.18先发出一个呼叫,0.24至0.29先发出4至12,这一差距并不取决于预算(所有互动都取决于0.36 p\geq 0.36 )。

blocks.en: 5.3 LLM Edit Patterns
blocks.zh: 5.3 半径 编辑图案

blocks.en: To obtain insights into the edit patterns of LLMs, we analyzed the submitted weight changes of the edit processes behind Tab. 1 , 292 of Astra and 308 of Opus. As detailed above, edits on ERM-trained networks observed in early runs motivated the edits that ERT rehearses (see Sec. 3.2 ). The observed edit processes confirm the pre-study observations: in 69 of its 73 edit processes on ERM-trained networks Opus edits the head, with a rank-one change along the contrast between support and reference images, and the paragraphs below show that this shape holds for all tasks, architectures and training methods.
blocks.zh: 为了深入了解LLMs的编辑模式,我们分析了Tab. 1、292 Astra和308 Opus后面提交的编辑过程的重量变化。 如上文详述的,早期运行中观察到的关于机构风险管理培训网络的编辑推动了ERT排练的编辑(见第3.2节)。 观察到的编辑过程证实了研究前的观察:关于机构风险管理培训网络的73个编辑过程中有69个 Opus编辑头部,沿支持和参考图像的对比度进行一级更改,下面段落显示,这个形状适用于所有任务,架构和培训方法.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Progress per edit. Net score (upper curves) and change in test accuracy (lower curves, as a fraction) after each of the 8 edit calls, averaged over the nine settings and all edit processes of Tab. 1 . Bands show ± 1 \pm 1 standard error.
blocks.zh: 图5:每次编辑的进展。 净分(上曲线)和测试精度变化(下曲线,作为一个分数)在8个编辑调用之后,平均在9个设置和Tab的所有编辑过程中. 1,乐队显示±1\pm 1标准错误.

blocks.en: To obtain insights on the progress during an edit process, we rebuilt the weights after every edit call from the logged tool calls and scored them like a submission (all 308 edit processes of Opus and 292 of Astra). Both editors reach most of their final net score with the first edit, which also costs the most accuracy on the full test sets (about − 10 -10 points for Opus, − 5 -5 to − 10 -10 for Astra). The later edits repair a substantial share of this side effect (see Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 为了了解编辑过程中的进展,我们在记录的工具调用每次编辑调用之后重建了权重,并把它们打成呈文(Opus和Astra的292的所有308编辑程序)。 两位编辑都通过第一次编辑达到了他们最终的净分数的大部分,这也在全测试集上成本最高(Opus约10-10分,Astra约5-5至10-10分). 后来的编辑修复了这一副作用的相当一部分(见图5).

blocks.en: Astra trades some success for fewer side effects after the first edit (ERT from 0.77 to 0.73, ERM from 0.69 to 0.63), whereas Opus passes through clearly worse intermediate states (0.50 to 0.58) before it recovers. ERT is ahead of ERM after every edit, by 0.04 to 0.13 for Opus and 0.03 to 0.12 for Astra, so the comparison does not depend on when an edit process is stopped.
blocks.zh: 在第一次编辑后,Astra以较少的副作用换取一些成功(ERT从0.77到0.73,ERM从0.69到0.63),而Opus在恢复之前则经过明显差的中间状态(0.50到0.58)。 ERT在每次编辑后都领先于机构风险管理,Opus以0.04比0.13,Astra以0.03比0.12,因此比较并不取决于编辑过程何时停止.

blocks.en: For all training methods, accuracy on the full test sets still ends 3 to 4 points below the unedited network after the final edit. Even with frontier LLMs, targeted edits by weight-space programming thus still can cost overall accuracy.
blocks.zh: 对所有训练方法而言,在最后编辑后,整个测试集的精度仍会低于未经编辑的网络3-4分. 即便有了前沿有限责任公司,按权重空间编程进行定向编辑仍能花费总体准确性。

blocks.en: Fig. 3 shows what the edit processes behind Tab. 1 change. Both editors almost always edit the final layer: Astra changes its weights in 291 of 292 edit processes and Opus in 296 of 308, in 151 and 199 of them together with its bias. Edits to the backbone are rare, 4 edit processes of Astra and 14 of Opus, and all but one of them change the batch-norm bias before the last ReLU of a ResNet-18. For Opus they concentrate on Waterbirds with ResNet-18 (12 of 48 edit processes, against 2 of 260 elsewhere), and on networks that were not prepared for editing: 5 of 8 edit processes on ERM networks and 2 of 8 with LS, against 4 of 16 on ENN and 1 of 16 on ERT networks.
blocks.zh: 图3显示 Tab 1 后面的编辑过程。 两位编辑几乎总是编辑最后一层: Astra在292个编辑流程中的291个和308个流程中的296个、151个和199个流程中的Opus及其偏差改变了其权重。 编辑到主干部是罕见的,Astra和Opus的14个编辑过程有4个,除了一个之外,它们都改变一个ResNet-18的最后一个ReLU之前的批号规范偏差. 对于 Opus公司将注意力集中在使用ResNet-18的Waterbirds(48个编辑程序中有12个,而其他260个程序中有2个)和未准备好进行编辑的网络上:机构风险管理网络的8个编辑程序中有5个,有8个程序中有2个是LS,而ENN的16个程序中有4个,有16个程序中有1个是ERT网络。

blocks.en: In every task, dataset and architecture, Opus’s change to the final layer is rank one (median share of its energy in the first singular value above 99% in every setting), confined to the rows of the source and the target class, and sparse (median 11 to 64 feature columns, 2–8% of the features). The columns are chosen by contrast. Of the eight features that differ most between the concept and the reference images, the edit contains 3.2 to 4.5, against 0.1 to 1.4 by chance. The training method does not seem to change this shape.
blocks.zh: 在每一项任务、数据集和架构中,Opus对最后一层的改变是第一层(在每一层中,其能量在第一个单数值中所占的中间份额超过99 % ) , 限于源和目标类的行,以及稀疏(中间11至64个特征列,占特征的2-8% ) 。 各栏以相对选. 在概念和参考图像之间差异最大的8个特征中,编辑包含3.2至4.5,而0.1至1.4是偶然的. 训练方法似乎没有改变这种形状。

blocks.en: Among closed-form edits computed from the same support images, the closest to Opus’s edits, on the entries it changed, is a rank-one re-route along the contrast, ERT’s direction rule without removal (mean cosine 0.72 to 0.93 on eight of the nine settings), followed by a gradient step, the edit ENN rehearses (0.51 to 0.87); on the Entity-30 confusion fix, neither is close (0.38 and 0.40). An LLM that edits by hand thus arrives at a sparse version of the edits that both edit-aware methods rehearse, and how gradient-like an edit is does not seem to predict which method wins.
blocks.zh: 在从同一支持图像计算出来的闭式编辑中,最接近Opus编辑的,在它所改变的条目上,是沿着对比度,ERT方向规则不移除的一级重排(在9个设置中的8个设置上,平均值为0.72至0.93),然后是梯度步骤,编辑ENN排练(0.51至0.87);在实体-30混淆修补上,两者都不接近(0.38和0.40)。 因此,手动编辑的LLM会得到一个稀少的编辑版本,既能预知编辑方法的排练,又能预知像梯度式的编辑如何似乎无法预测哪种方法获胜.

blocks.en: What differs between training methods is the size of the edit. On Waterbirds with ResNet-18, Opus’s change to the classifier weights is about five times larger on ERM-trained networks than on prepared ones (median ℓ 2 \ell_{2} norm 7.5, against 1.4 for ERT and 1.6 for ENN), with a similar number of changed units. Preparation thus does not change what kind of edit Opus makes, as it makes a small, ordinary edit sufficient where an ERM-trained network needs a large one or an edit inside the backbone.
blocks.zh: 培训方法的不同之处在于编辑的大小。 在有ResNet-18的Waterbirds上,Opus在机构风险管理培训的网络上对分类器权重的改变比准备的网络(中间值 l 2\ell\2}规范7.5)大五倍,而ERT和ENN则分别是1.4和1.6),变化单位的数目相似。 因此,准备工作不会改变Opus编辑的种类,因为它使一个经过机构风险管理培训的网络需要大型编辑或主干内部编辑的小型普通编辑足够。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We presented the first systematic study of weight-space programming for vision models, with a benchmark of LLM agents that edit trained classifiers and with Edit-Ready Training (ERT), which rehearses the head edits these agents write. Over more than 2,600 scored edit processes, ERT has the highest mean net score for both GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5. Further, standard networks already support targeted edits in easy settings, and preparation pays off where they resist.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了对视觉模型的权重空间编程的首次系统研究,其中有一个LLM代理编辑经过训练的分类器的基准,以及Edit-Ready Training(ERT),它排练了这些代理编辑头部的编辑. 超过2600个得分的编辑过程,ERT在GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5中均拥有最高的均值净分. 此外,标准网络已经在轻松的环境中支持目标编辑,而准备则在抵制时有所回报。

blocks.en: Our study also leaves several directions open. It covers image classification with three backbones and four datasets. Other vision tasks, larger backbones and generative models remain to be tested. With 8 to 16 paired edit processes per cell, only large differences between methods are detectable. Hyperparameters were tuned and baselines selected with scripted editors on ResNet-18 rather than with agents. Finally, with every training method, edits still lower test accuracy. Preparation that also preserves accuracy, rehearsal of edits inside the backbone or tailored to a specific editor, and sequences of edits to one network are natural next steps. We release all tasks, trajectories and scores so that new methods and editors can be compared directly.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究还留下了几个方向。 它包含三个骨干和四个数据集的图像分类. 其他愿景任务、更大的骨干和基因模型仍有待测试。 每个单元格有8至16对齐的编辑过程,只有方法之间的巨大差异是可以察觉的. 在ResNet-18上对超参数进行了调制,并用脚本编辑器选择基线,而不是使用代理。 最后,使用每一种训练方法,编辑的测试精度仍然较低. 同时保持准确性的准备,主干内部编辑的排练或针对特定编辑器的定制,和一个网络的编辑顺序是自然的下一步. 我们发布所有的任务,轨迹和分数,这样就可以直接比较新方法和编辑器.

Prefer targeted, principled edits that generalize over edits that merely memorize the support examples. Use forward probes to understand the model before editing. Call submit() when done; if you never submit, the original weights are scored.
blocks.zh: 任务目标:设立分组 PACS 系统 给您一个训练有素的 C- C 类图像分类器和一个带有两个分组的小标签支持集 。 第1分组载有从一种输入中抽取的一个类别的例子,该模式在其中表现不佳;第1分组的标签是其正确的类别。 第0分组是一组其他例子的参考,标注在模型的当前预测上,不能改变。 直接编辑现有的权重,使模型将输入像第1分组一样进行正确分类,同时尽可能少改变其他预测. 您得分的是模型目前错误分类的同类和类的被搁置实例(现在分类正确),以及被搁置实例(目前正确预测的被搁置,但始终正确);这两个问题。 偏爱有针对性、原则性的编辑, 编辑前使用前置探测器来了解模型. 完成后调用提交();如果从未提交,则原始的权重会得分.

blocks.en: A.4 How the editors were run
blocks.zh: A.4 联合国 编辑们是如何运行的

blocks.en: Tools, budget, system prompt and user message are identical for all editors. The harnesses that run them differ in three points.
blocks.zh: 工具、预算、系统即时和用户信息对所有编辑都相同。 运行它们的绳索有三点不同.

blocks.en: runs at default effort as a sub-agent of Claude Code that has access to the WeightLab tools only. It is limited to 150 model turns, where one turn is one model response that may contain several tool calls.
blocks.zh: 以默认努力运行,作为Claude Code的子代理,只能访问WeightLab工具. 它仅限于150个模型转弯,一个转弯是一个模型响应,可能包含几个工具调用.

blocks.en: runs at high reasoning effort in the Codex command-line agent, whose base instructions are replaced by the system prompt above and whose only tools are those of WeightLab. It has no turn limit, and an edit process ends when the model stops. Every transcript was audited for tool use outside WeightLab.
blocks.zh: 运行在 Codex 命令行代理中的高度推理工作,其基础指令被上面的系统提示所取代,其唯一的工具是WeightLab的工具. 它没有转弯限制,一个编辑过程在模型停止时结束. 每份记录稿都经过审核,用于WeightLab以外的工具.

blocks.en: GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (low reasoning effort) and Gemma-4-26B (thinking mode) run in a chat-completions loop with the same limit of 150 turns and at most 32,000 output tokens per turn. Tool outputs longer than 30,000 characters are truncated with a notice, so that they fit the context windows of these models.
blocks.zh: GLM-5.3-Flash和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash(低推理努力)和Gemma-4-26B(思维模式)在聊天-补全循环中运行,每回合限制相同,最多为32,000个输出令牌. 工具输出超过30,000个字符会被切换并带有通知,以便适合这些模型的上下文窗口.

blocks.en: The open-weight models sometimes end a turn without a tool call before they have submitted. In this case, they receive the neutral reminder
blocks.zh: 开放量级模型有时会在提交之前结束一个回合,没有工具呼叫. 这样的话,他们就会收到中性的警告,

blocks.en: Continuation reminder open-weight editors only Continue. Use the tools, and call submit() when you are done.
blocks.zh: 继续提醒开量编辑器只继续 。 使用工具,并在完成后调用提交() 。

blocks.en: at most three times per edit process. After the third reminder, the edit process ends, and the original weights are scored unless the editor has submitted. Astra and Opus receive no reminders. The reminders are logged for every edit process.
blocks.zh: 每个编辑过程最多三次。 在第三次提醒后,编辑过程结束,除非编辑者已经提交,否则原始的权重会被打分. Astra和Opus没有收到任何提醒。 每个编辑过程都会记录提醒。

blocks.en: The edit processes of one editor ran strictly one at a time, in shuffled order within each grid. The ERM and LS arms of most settings were added one to three days after the ENN and ERT arms of the same edit requests, with the same tool server and prompt; they were not interleaved. An edit process was excluded and rebuilt only after an infrastructure failure before submission, such as a lost connection. A submitted edit process was never excluded.
blocks.zh: 一个编辑器的编辑过程严格一次运行一个,按照每个网格内部的洗牌顺序进行. 大多数设置的ERM和LS臂,是在相同的编辑请求的ENN和ERT臂后一至三天增加的,具有相同的工具服务器,并且是及时的;它们没有互换. 编辑过程被排除,只有在提交前基础设施失败,例如连接丢失后才重建。 提交的编辑程序从未被排除 。

blocks.en: Appendix B Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 培训详情

blocks.en: This section complements Sec. 4.1 .

blocks.en: All networks start from ImageNet weights and are trained with SGD (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , momentum 0.9, weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , gradient-norm clipping at 5). Each training batch holds 64 images. ENN and ERT add four episodes of four support and four query images, and the reference images of an episode are the batch images of other concepts. On the multi-class datasets, ERT and ENN draw a random target class per episode.
blocks.zh: 所有网络都从ImageNet的权重开始,经过SGD(学习率10-3 10^{-3},动力0.9,重量衰减10-4 10^{-4},梯度-规范剪辑5)的训练. 每批培训有64幅图像。 ENN和ERT增加了4集4个支持和4个查询图像,一个集的参考图像是其他概念的批量图像. 在多类数据集上,ERT和ENN每集画一个随机的目标类.

blocks.en: The concepts that the editors later relabel are excluded from the training episodes of ENN and ERT, on Waterbirds (8 species) and on CIFAR-100 (16 fine classes). On PACS, the (class, sketch) cells that are fixed later are excluded. The images of these concepts remain in the training set with their original labels. Section F.2 measures how much this exclusion matters.
blocks.zh: 编辑们后来重新贴上标签的概念被排除在ENN和ERT、水鸟(8种)和CIFAR-100(16个精品课)的培训班之外。 在PACS上,不包括后来固定的(类,草图)单元格. 这些概念的图像仍保留在带有其原始标签的训练集中. F.2节衡量这种排除的重要性。

blocks.zh: B.1 超参数调制

blocks.en: Table 3 : Search spaces. All combinations were trained with ResNet-18 on Waterbirds and CIFAR-100, on two training seeds that are used for nothing else. The lower block lists the methods that were only part of the baseline screen ( Sec. B.2 ).

blocks.en: Table 4 : Selected settings. LS uses strength 0.2 everywhere. ViT-B/16 networks reuse the ResNet-18 settings of their dataset, and PACS and Entity-30 reuse the settings selected on CIFAR-100.

blocks.en: All methods were tuned with the same protocol, fixed in advance, with ResNet-18 on Waterbirds and on CIFAR-100. Table 3 lists the search spaces. Every combination was trained on two training seeds (5 and 6) that appear in no reported result, and was scored on validation data with three scripted editors: the two ERT edit rules and a single gradient step on the head. The selection score is the mean success minus side effect of these editors on validation concepts. Among the settings whose validation accuracy is within two points of ERM, the one with the highest score was selected. No LLM was involved in tuning.
blocks.zh: 所有方法都采用事先固定的相同协议,在水鸟和CIFAR-100上采用ResNet-18。 表3列出了搜索空间。 每个组合都接受了两个训练种子(5和6)的培训,没有报告结果出现,在验证数据上得到3个脚本编辑器的分数:两个ERT编辑规则和头一个梯度步骤. 选择分数是这些编辑器在验证概念上的平均成功率减去副作用. 在审定准确度在机构风险管理两个点之内的设置中,选择了得分最高的设置。 没有LLM参与调音.

blocks.en: Table 4 lists the selected values. On CIFAR-100, both ERT and ENN are combined with LS, since this improved both in the same protocol. For ENN on Waterbirds, the initially selected λ l = 1 \lambda_{l}=1 lay at the upper end of its range. We therefore extended the range to { 5 , 20 } \{5,20\} , which selected λ l = 5 \lambda_{l}=5 . The ResNet-18 network had been trained before this extension and uses λ l = 1 \lambda_{l}=1 , whereas the ViT-B/16 network uses λ l = 5 \lambda_{l}=5 ; with scripted editors, the two values differ by 0.01 in mean net score. For ERT, an extended grid on Waterbirds ( λ e \lambda_{e} up to 10, λ l \lambda_{l} from 0.2 to 20) left the selection unchanged.
blocks.zh: 表4列出了选定的数值。 在CIFAR-100上,ERT和ENN都与LS结合,因为两者在同一协议中都有改进. 对于水鸟上的ENN,最初选择的λl=1\lambda_{l}=1位于其射程的上端. 因此,我们把范围扩大至{5,20}}{5,20}}}{5,20 }}},它们选择了\ l = 5\ lambda_{l}=5。 ResNet-18网络在本次扩展之前就受过训练,使用QQ l = 1\lambda_{l}=1,而ViT-B/16网络使用QQ l = 5\lambda_{l}=5;有了脚本编辑器,两个数值在平均净分中以0.01的差值. 对ERT来说,水鸟的扩展网格(QQ e\lambda_{e)最高可达10,QQ l\lambda_{l}从0.2到20)没有改变选择.

blocks.zh: B.2 基线屏幕

Gain : difference to ERM, averaged over datasets and checkpoints. No LLM is involved. Bold: best method of a column.
blocks.zh: 表5:带有脚本编辑器的基准屏幕. ResNet-18网络的6名编稿编辑的平均净分,在早期和最后一个检查站平均为5个培训种子。 收益:与机构风险管理的差异,平均超过数据集和检查站。 没有LLM参与。 粗体:柱式最佳方法.

blocks.en: LLM edit processes are expensive, so the baselines of the main text were chosen by a screen without LLMs ( Tab. 5 ). Ten training methods were tuned as described above and trained with ResNet-18 on Waterbirds and CIFAR-100 over five training seeds. Each network was then edited by six scripted editors on the test concepts: the two ERT edit rules, three sparse refits of the head that are restricted to 1, 4 and 16 feature units, and a rescaling of 32 channels in the last block of the backbone.
blocks.zh: LLM编辑过程昂贵,因此正文的基线是由没有LLMs(Tab. 5)的屏幕选择的. 如上文所述,对10种培训方法进行了调整,并用ResNet-18进行了关于水鸟和CIFAR-100的5种培训种子的培训。 每个网络随后由6位脚本编辑就测试概念进行编辑:两条ERT编辑规则,3条限制在1,4和16个功能单元的头部的稀疏改版,以及骨干最后一个块的32个频道的缩放.

blocks.en: Sharpness-aware minimization and dropout are indistinguishable from ERM in this screen. Auxiliary concept labels and a sparse final layer gain + 0.09 +0.09 and + 0.13 +0.13 , below LS ( + 0.19 +0.19 ), ERT ( + 0.22 +0.22 ) and ENN ( + 0.24 +0.24 ). We therefore gave the three leading methods and ERM to the LLM editors, with LS added to ERT and ENN where it was selected. The Waterbirds networks of this screen were trained before the species were held out from the episodes ( Sec. F.2 ), so the screen was used only for selecting the baselines.
blocks.zh: 尖锐意识-尽量减少和辍学与本屏幕中的机构风险管理是分不开的。 辅助概念标签和一个稀疏的最终层增益+0.09+0.09和+0.13+0.13,低于LS(+0.19+0.19),ERT(+0.22+0.22)和ENN(+0.24+0.24),因此,我们把三种主要方法和机构风险管理交给了LLM编辑,在ERT和ENN中加入了LS,选择了LS. 本屏幕的水鸟网络在物种脱离剧集(Sec.F.2)之前就接受了训练,因此该屏幕仅用于选择基线.

blocks.en: Waterbirds: 8 bird species, training seed 0; for Opus with ResNet-18, ENN and ERT are also edited on seed 1. CIFAR-100: 8 of the 16 held-out fine classes for relabeling, and the 8 superclass pairs with the highest validation confusion for the confusion fix, seed 0. PACS: the 4 (class, sketch) cells with the lowest validation accuracy, seeds 0 and 1. Entity-30: the 3 class pairs with the highest validation confusion, seeds 0 to 2.
blocks.zh: 水鸟:鸟类8种,培养种0;对配有ResNet-18的Opus,ENN和ERT也编辑种子1. CIFAR-100:16个被搁置的精品课中的8个重新贴标签,8个超级对错位的验证混乱度最高的组合,种子0. PACS:验证精度最低的4(类,素描)单元格,种子0和1. 实体-30:3个等级组合,验证混乱程度最高,种子0比2.

blocks.en: The support set holds five images of the concept for relabeling, and eight images of the target group, labeled with their correct class, for the two fix tasks. The reference set holds 64 validation images of other concepts, labeled with the predictions of the respective network. All training methods of a setting share the same support and reference images.
blocks.zh: 支持集持有5个概念的图像用于重新贴标签,8个目标群体的图像被贴上正确的分类标签,用于两个固定任务. 该参考集保存着64幅其他概念的验证图像,贴有相应网络的预测. 一个设定的所有培训方法都共享同样的支持和参考图像.

blocks.en: The intervals in Tab. 1 are nonparametric percentile bootstrap intervals over the edit processes of a cell (10,000 resamples); the mean column resamples within each setting. A cell has 8 edit processes, except on Entity-30 (9) and for ENN and ERT on Waterbirds with ResNet-18 and Opus (16, over two training seeds). The paired sign-flip test is exact for up to 18 pairs. With 8 pairs, its smallest attainable p p -value is 0.008, and with 9 pairs 0.004.
blocks.zh: Tab. 1 中的间隔是单元格编辑过程中的非参数百分位制的靴子间隔(10,000个复刻);在每个设置中的平均列复刻。 一个单元格有8个编辑程序,但实体-30(9)和水鸟的ENN和ERT有ResNet-18和Opus(16,两个训练种子以上)除外。 成对的标志-flip测试精确到18对. 有8对,其最小可实现p-值为0.008,有9对0.004.

blocks.en: For the mean gain over ERM, we report two tests. The first uses all 73 pairs of edit processes of an editor, flips signs within pairs and weights the nine settings equally (20,000 random flips). It tests whether a method changes the outcome on these nine settings. The second takes the nine settings as units (exact sign-flip test over the setting means) and asks whether the gain would carry over to new settings.
blocks.zh: 为了从机构风险管理中获得平均收益,我们报告了两项测试。 第一种是使用编辑器的所有73对编辑过程,在对内翻转标志,对9个设置进行同等的加权(20,000随机翻转). 它测试一种方法是否改变这九种设置的结果. 第二种将9个设置作为单位(精确的在设置手段上进行标志-flip测试),并询问收益是否会结转到新的设置中.

blocks.en: For each setting, the paired edit requests are split at random into two halves. The net score on the ERM network is taken from one half and the gain (method minus ERM) from the other. The rank correlation over the nine settings is computed for 2,000 random splits, and we report its median and the share of negative values. Because the two halves share no edit processes, noise in the ERM score cannot create the correlation.
blocks.zh: 对于每个设置,对齐的编辑请求随机分成两个半个. 机构风险管理网络的净得分取自一半,收益(方法减去机构风险管理)取自另一半。 相对于9个设置的排名相关性是按2000个随机分割计算,我们报告它的中位数和负值的比例。 由于两个半部分没有编辑过程,机构风险管理分数中的噪音不能产生相关性。

blocks.en: F.1 Which edit should ERT rehearse?
blocks.zh: F.1 联合国 ERT 要排练哪个编辑 ?

blocks.en: Table 10 : Which edit should ERT rehearse? Net score of Opus on Waterbirds with ResNet-18 when the edit simulated during training is varied and everything else is kept. Δ \Delta is the paired difference to the reference of the same block on the same species, with the number of pairs won and the sign-flip p p -value. The two blocks were run separately, each with its own reference edit processes. No variant differs reliably from the reference.

blocks.en: ERT rehearses two closed-form edit rules, and one may expect that rehearsing edits closer to what the LLM later writes would help more. We varied the simulated edit on Waterbirds with ResNet-18, the setting with the largest gain from preparation at that time, retrained the network and gave it to Opus ( Tab. 10 ).
blocks.zh: ERT排练了两条封闭式编辑规则,人们可能期望排练编辑更接近LLM后来写的东西会帮助更多. 我们用ResNet-18对Waterbirds上的模拟编辑进行了修改,这个设置从当时的准备中获得了最大的收益,重新训练了这个网络并将其交给了Opus(Tab.10)。

blocks.en: Opus’s own edits change more units than the top-8 rule, shift the class bias and often overshoot the margin ( Sec. 5.3 ). The variants therefore enlarge or randomize the number of units, scale the step size by a random factor between 1 and 3, shift the bias so that the mean reference logits stay unchanged, or add sparse edits with the size statistics of Opus’s edits to the two rules. A further variant adds ENN’s gradient step as a third rule, and stronger rehearsal draws 16 instead of 4 episodes per step, marks 64 units and uses two support images.
blocks.zh: 奥普斯自己编辑的单位变化比前8规则要多,转移阶级偏差,并经常过度射击比值(第5.3节). 因此,变体会扩大或随机划分单位数量,在1至3之间以随机因数标出步数大小,将偏差移动,使平均参考数保持不变,或者用Opus编辑的大小统计加入零散编辑到两个规则中。 另一个变体增加了ENN的梯度阶梯作为第三条规则,更强大的排练抽取16集而不是每步4集,标记64个单位,并使用两个支持图像.

blocks.en: No variant differs reliably from the reference: the differences range from − 0.06 -0.06 to + 0.06 +0.06 , and none is significant. Two variants that moved furthest toward Opus’s edits could not be tested at all, because they lowered the accuracy of the unedited network (for an edit fitted directly to Opus’s edits, 88.9% against 92.9%).
blocks.zh: 无变体与参考文献有可靠差异:差异范围为−0.06-0.06至+0.06+0.06,无显著差异. 两种最接近Opus编辑的变体完全无法测试,因为它们降低了未经编辑的网络的精度(直接与Opus编辑相匹配的编辑,88.9%对92.9%)。

blocks.en: Stronger rehearsal, the only variant with the same gain on both training seeds, was then trained for eight of the nine settings, all but the Entity-30 confusion fix ( Tab. 11 ). It is ahead of the reference in three of them and behind in five (mean difference − 0.03 -0.03 ), and the only significant difference is a gain on PACS with ResNet-18 ( + 0.07 +0.07 , 7 of 8 pairs, p = 0.02 p=0.02 ). On ViT-B/16, where about half of the entries Opus changes are negative, we also replaced the top-8 rule by a signed sparse edit. It changed the net score by − 0.01 -0.01 on Waterbirds and by + 0.03 +0.03 on CIFAR-100 relabeling (both p > 0.3 p>0.3 ).
blocks.zh: 更强的排练是唯一在两种训练种子上都有相同收益的变种,随后在9个设置中8个都接受了训练,除了实体-30的迷惑修补(Tab. 11)之外. 它在其中3个和后面5个(平均差数−0.03−0.03)的参考值领先,唯一显著的区别是使用ResNet-18的PACS增益(+0.07+0.07,8对中的7对,p=0.02). 在Vit-B/16上,约一半的条目Opus更改为负数,我们也用签名的稀疏编辑取代了前8规则. 它改变了水鸟类的净分数−0.01-0.01,CIFAR-100重贴标签的比分+0.03+0.03(均大于0.3 p>0.3).

blocks.en: The benefit of ERT thus does not depend on matching the editor’s edit closely. Together with the finding that Opus writes the same kind of edit on every network ( Sec. 5.3 ), this suggests that rehearsal shapes the features so that small head edits work in general, and not one particular edit.
blocks.zh: 因此,ERT的好处并不取决于编辑者的编辑是否紧密匹配。 加上Opus在每一个网络上都写同样类型的编辑(sec. 5.3)的发现,这表明排练会塑造特征,这样小头编辑一般工作,而不是一个特定的编辑.

blocks.en: F.2 Held-out concepts
blocks.zh: F.2 联合国 被搁置的概念

blocks.en: Table 12 : Held-out concepts on Waterbirds. Net score when the edited species were part of the training episodes ( rehearsed ) and when they were excluded from them ( held out ), for the same edit requests. Cells have 8 edit processes (16 for Opus with ResNet-18). The main text reports the held-out networks.
blocks.zh: 表12:关于水鸟的废弃概念。 当编辑的物种是训练节目(排练)的一部分时,当它们被排除在外时(举行),对于同样的编辑请求,净得分. 单元格有8个编辑进程(16个Opus和ResNet-18). 主文报道被搁置的网络.

blocks.en: Edit episodes may only use concepts that are not edited later ( Sec. 3.2 ). To measure how much this matters, we compare two versions of the Waterbirds ENN and ERT networks that differ only in this point. In the rehearsed version, the 8 species that are relabeled later, each with 22 to 26 training images, took part in the training episodes. The test images that score an edit were unseen, but the concept and its target class were not. In the held-out version, which the main text reports, these species are excluded from the episodes. Nothing was retuned, and the accuracy of the unedited networks differs by about one point at most.
blocks.zh: 编辑片段只能使用后来没有编辑过的概念(第3.2节). 为了衡量这有多重要,我们比较了水鸟ENN和ERT两个版本的网络,这两个版本仅在此时不同. 在排练的版本中,后来重新贴上标签的8个物种,每个物种都有22到26个训练图像,参加了训练集. 评分编辑的测试图像是看不见的,但概念及其目标类却并非如此. 在主文报告的搁置版本中,这些物种被排除在剧集之外. 没有重新调整,未经编辑的网络的准确性最多有一点不同。

blocks.en: Table 12 shows both versions for all five editors. For Opus, holding out the species lowers the net score of ERT by 0.08 over both backbones (24 pairs, p = 0.02 p=0.02 ) and that of ENN by 0.05 ( p = 0.24 p=0.24 ). For Astra, neither changes (ERT + 0.01 +0.01 , p = 0.86 p=0.86 ; ENN − 0.01 -0.01 , p = 0.65 p=0.65 ; 16 pairs each). The gain of ERT over ERM remains with held-out species, with + 0.29 +0.29 for Opus (24 pairs, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; edit processes on training seed 1 are paired with the ERM edit process of the same species) and + 0.23 +0.23 for Astra (16 pairs, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) over both backbones. A part of the benefit of ERT for Opus on Waterbirds thus comes from having rehearsed the concept itself, and the larger part carries over to concepts that were never rehearsed. For the open-weight editors, the differences between the two versions have both signs and reflect the high variance of these editors.
blocks.zh: 表12列出所有五个编辑的两种版本。 对奥普斯来说,持有该物种将ERT净分比两个骨干都低0.08(24对,p = 0.02 p = 0.02),ENN净分比0.05(p = 0.24 p = 0.24),对Astra来说,两者都不改变(ERT + 0.01 + 0.01,p = 0.86;ENN → 0.01 - 0.01,p = 0.65 p = 0.65;各16对). ERT对机构风险管理的增益仍然是被搁置的物种,Opus的增益是+0.29+0.29(24对,p < 0.001 p < 0.001);培训种子1的编辑过程与同一物种的机构风险管理编辑过程成对),Astra的增益是+0.23+0.23(16对,p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。 Opus on Waterbirds的ERT的好处之一,就是排练了概念本身,而更大的部分则延续到从未排练过的概念. 对于开放量级编辑,两个版本之间的差异既具有标志性,也反映了这些编辑的高度差异.

blocks.zh: 每行都是一个编辑过程. 网络因编辑过程不同而不同,因此头单位无法通过它们的索引对齐. 相反,每行列出编辑所改变的单位,从最大的变化到最小的改变,颜色给出变化的大小,以l 2\ell\\2}的规范来衡量单位的栏目的等级为 \\ W\Delta W。 因此,一行以编辑的单位数结束,一行无色不改变头重. 这两个数字显示的是相同的一行,按骨干和编辑分类。

blocks.en: Opus changes few units (median 25) by a comparatively large amount. Astra changes many units by small amounts (on average 206 of 512 units on ResNet-18 and 638 of 768 on ViT-B/16) and rewrites the whole head in 62 of 292 edit processes (37 of them on ResNet-18). DeepSeek (median 45 units) and GLM (median 20) lie in between; GLM changes no head weight in 57 of 251 edit processes. Gemma leaves the weights untouched in 135 of 251 edit processes, which agrees with its low net score, and otherwise either changes a handful of units or the whole head (25 edit processes). Edits outside the head are rare for every editor: 14 of Opus’s 308 edit processes also change a tensor in the backbone (13 of them on ResNet-18), 6 of GLM’s, 4 of Astra’s and 1 of Gemma’s. Within an editor, the rows of the four training methods look alike. The training method does not change which kind of edit an editor writes, in line with Sec. 5.3 .
blocks.zh: Opus改变的单位很少(中间值为25),数量相对较大. Astra通过小额改变许多单位(ResNet-18上的512个单位中平均206个,Vit-B/16上的768个单位中平均638个),并在292个编辑过程中的62个(ResNet-18上的37个)重写整头. DeepSeek(中45个单位)和GLM(中20个单位)位于两者之间;GLM在251个编辑过程中的57个没有改变头重. Gemma在251个编辑过程中的135个中将权重置之不动,这与它的低净分一致,否则会改变少数单位或整个头部(25个编辑过程). 每个编辑都很少看到头部外的编辑:在Opus的308编辑过程中,有14个也会改变骨干里的一个呼号(其中13个在ResNet-18上),6个GLM,4个Astra和1个Gemma. 在编辑内部,四种训练方法的行相类似. 训练方法不会改变编辑者按照5.3节写的编辑方式。

blocks.en: Table 14 gives the minimum, mean and maximum of the number of edited units, of the change of a single unit and of the change of the whole head ( ‖ Δ ​ W ‖ F \|\Delta W\|_{F} ). The minimum of the change of a unit is bounded by the threshold of 10 − 7 10^{-7} above which we count a weight as changed, and reflects whole-head operations that leave most units almost unchanged. The means are dominated by a few very large edits, in particular of Gemma on ViT-B/16 (largest head change 5,693), so the lower block should not be read as a comparison of the training methods.
blocks.zh: 表14给出了编辑单位的最小,平均和最大数量,单单位的变更和整头的变更(QQ W QQ F QQDelta WQQF}). 单位变更的最小值以10−7 10^{-7}的阈值为界,以上我们算一个权重变化,并反映大部分单位几乎不变的全头操作. 手段以少数非常大的编辑为主,尤其是VIT-B/16上的Gemma(最大头部变化5,693),因此下方块不应被解读为训练方法的比较.

blocks.en: G.3 Edit similarity and score
blocks.zh: G.3 编辑相似性和分数

blocks.en: How similar an Opus edit is to a gradient step does not tell which method wins. Over the 75 paired ENN and ERT edit processes behind the main table, no measure of this similarity is positively related to the advantage of ENN (rank correlations − 0.29 -0.29 to + 0.20 +0.20 , none positive with p < 0.05 p<0.05 ). Features of the edit also barely predict its score. Only on CIFAR-100 relabeling with ResNet-18 does the net score rise with the similarity to all three closed-form reference edits (rank correlation 0.62 to 0.65, 32 edit processes); elsewhere the correlations are at most 0.65 in absolute value, with mixed signs.
blocks.zh: Opus 编辑与梯度阶梯的相似度并不显示哪种方法获胜 。 在主表后面的75个对齐的ENN和ERT编辑进程上,没有衡量这种相似性的尺度与ENN的优势有正比关系(排名相关性−0.29-0.29至+0.20+0.20,无正比与p < 0.05 p < 0.05). 编辑的特征也几乎无法预测它的分数. 仅在CIFAR-100重贴ResNet-18上,净分随所有三个闭式参考编辑的相似性而上升(排名0.62至0.65,32个编辑过程);在其他地方,相关值在绝对值上最多为0.65,有混合的标志.

The median edit process takes about three minutes for Astra and Opus, with a median of 252 and 27 changed weights.

blocks.en: The edit processes were made on 109 networks. Together with hyperparameter tuning, ablations and training seeds, we trained about 1,300 networks. Training them, including the evaluations during training, took about 385 GPU-hours (summed from the training logs), about 320 on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs and about 65 on NVIDIA H100 and A100 GPUs. Scoring the edited networks adds only a few hours. The three open-weight editors consumed about 750 million prompt tokens.
blocks.zh: 109个网络进行了编辑。 加上超参数调试、烧烤和培训种子,我们培训了大约1 300个网络。 对他们进行培训,包括培训期间的评估,大约花费了385个GPU小时(从培训记录中总结),大约花费了320个NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU,大约花费了65个NVIDIA H100和A100 GPU. 扫描编辑过的网络只增加几个小时。 三位开放量级编辑消耗了约7.5亿个即时符号.
